responsibility: This definition file declares the small set of ACLE NEON-SVE bridge builtin families that move data between fixed-width NEON vectors and SVE vectors. Through `DEF_NEON_SVE_FUNCTION` entries such as `svset_neonq`, `svget_neonq`, and `svdup_neonq`, it provides the declarative builtin inventory that the AArch64 intrinsic machinery uses to register and resolve the bridge operations separately from the main NEON and SVE builtin tables.
